opportunities.title: Small Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds; individuals are not accepted unless they can provide organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for projects that bring UK and Japan together across arts, culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, and sport, supporting festivals, exchanges, collaborative projects, teaching, and academic research.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year (maximum £30,000 total for up to three years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record in medicine or health, though practitioners, managers, carers, or early‑career individuals are also welcome; must involve UK‑Japan partnership and referees not from the same institution.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, covering travel, conference, and publication costs for projects of mutual benefit.
